caption: 封港前夜废弃灯塔守塔人失踪，调查员林远与维修员林岚登门追查，发现守塔人常去的维修通道被人从外撬开，线索直指灯塔地下的封闭维修间。

shots.title: 封港前的荒原
shots.subtitle: 风雪中的沉默
shots.prompt: 黑白灰调的海岸线，风雪将海边的废弃码头和灯塔融为一片。海风呼啸，卷起黄沙与残雪，灯塔的铁门半开，暗示着有人进出。前景中，一位身着风衣的调查员林远站定，手中紧握着一块沾满盐雾的调查记录板，目光穿透风雪，望向灯塔的入口。背后是静止的维修员林岚，身穿标志性的黄色雨衣，面容严肃，默默守候。

shots.title: 地下的秘密
shots.subtitle: 暗影中的抉择
shots.prompt: 镜头穿过破败的码头大门，跟随林远与林岚的脚步，进入灯塔内部阴暗的石阶。光线逐渐暗淡，只有手电筒投射出微弱的光晕。空气中弥漫着潮湿与霉味。两人小心翼翼地下探，林远的记录板反射出微光，而林岚黄色的雨衣在黑暗中格外显眼，像是一道鲜明的警示色。他们发现了守塔人曾经挖掘的地下维修间的痕迹，墙上留有被打扰的痕迹，暗示着紧张的藏身与追踪。

detailed_description:
The video is a cinematic thriller-mystery with high-contrast lighting and a gritty, atmospheric tone. 
[Shot 1] The camera performs a smooth tracking shot, moving through the rusted, decaying gates of a dilapidated pier to follow <Subject 1> and <Subject 2> as they walk into the dark, winding stone staircase of the lighthouse. <Subject 1> holds a metal clipboard that glints faintly under the beam of a flashlight held in her other hand. <Subject 2> walks beside her, her bright yellow raincoat providing a sharp visual contrast against the gloomy, damp stone walls. The air looks thick with moisture and dust, visible in the weak light beams cutting through the darkness. 
[Shot 2] At 00:02.000, the shot cuts to a low-angle POV-style movement as they enter a hidden underground maintenance room. The walls here are marked with signs of disturbance—scuff marks and jagged scratches—suggesting frantic hiding or a recent chase. <Subject 1> pans her flashlight across the wall, revealing rough masonry and old tools discarded. <Subject 2> leans in closer, her expression tense as she examines the marks. The camera shakes slightly to convey the tension and the physical effort of exploring the space.

overall_soundscape:
The sound of heavy boots echoing on damp stone steps, the rhythmic dripping of water from the ceiling, and the low hum of a flashlight electronic circuit. Distant wind whistles through the pier structure outside.

non_diegetic_music:
A low-frequency ambient drone with subtle, tense metallic pulses creates a sense of mounting suspense and mystery.
